{%- comment -%}
An index of the site for AI agents and LLMs, following https://llmstxt.org.
_scripts/export-markdown.rb reads the built file and writes /llms-full.txt from
the Markdown links in it, in the same order.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign profile = site.data.profile -%}
{%- comment -%} Same list as the blog index: posts plus pages that live in _posts/. {%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign legacy_posts = site.pages | where_exp: "p", "p.dir == '/_posts/'" -%}
{%- assign posts = site.posts | concat: legacy_posts | where_exp: "p", "p.published != false" | where_exp: "p", "p.title" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
{%- assign notes = site.notes | where_exp: "n", "n.published != false" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
{%- assign about = site.pages | where: "url", "/about/" | first -%}
{%- assign resume = site.pages | where: "url", "/resume/" | first -%}
# {{ profile.name }}

> {{ profile.summary }}

This is the personal site of {{ profile.name }}, {{ profile.job_title | downcase }} at [{{ profile.works_for.name }}]({{ profile.works_for.url }}). The blog has posts on learning and thinking, and the notes explain topics from first principles: GPUs, transformers, tokenizers, training, auth and authorization. Every page below is linked as plain Markdown. The HTML version of each page is at the same path, ending in `.html` (or `/` for About and Resume).

- Website: {{ "/" | absolute_url }}
- GitHub: https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}
- X: https://x.com/{{ site.twitter_username }}
- Email: {{ site.email }}
- Resume PDF: {{ "/assets/files/Janaki_Resume.pdf" | absolute_url }}
